# User Guide — Whiteboarder
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Overview
Whiteboarder can:
- create flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, system architectures, and mind maps;
- generate diagrams from plain-language prompts;
- convert sketches into editable nodes and connections;
- import Mermaid, SQL, draw.io, and Excalidraw diagrams;
- edit diagrams through chat or directly on the canvas;
- arrange, save, reopen, search, and export boards.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Workspace
A board contains a structured diagram canvas, an optional freehand canvas, a chat panel, and a header with the board name and save state.
Figure 1. Whiteboarder workspace.
| Control | Function |
| All boards | Open the board list. |
| New | Start another board. |
| Save | Save the diagram, sketch, chat, and thumbnail. |
| Draw / Diagram / Draw + Diagram | Switch between freehand, structured, or combined work. |
| Auto layout | Rearrange nodes for clearer spacing. |
| AI fix | Review and repair layout problems. |
| Ask | Ask about the current board or request an edit. |
| Import / Export | Bring in or download diagram content. |

──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Create a board
- Open All boards.
- Select New board.
- Enter a board name.
- Select Blank board or a template.
- Select Create board.
Figure 2. New board dialog.
Templates include Flow chart, Sequence diagram, Mind Map, ER Diagram, and System Architecture.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Generate and edit a diagram
- Select Diagram or Draw + Diagram.
- Enter a prompt describing the diagram, its important nodes, and their connections.
- Submit the prompt in the chat panel.
- Review the generated nodes and edges on the canvas.
- Ask for changes in the same conversation.
Example:
Create a flowchart for login with OTP verification, invalid-code retry, success, and failure states.
Figure 3. Diagram generation and editing.
WB-07. The prompt, generated login flow, and assistant response.
### AI layout and AI fix
After generating or editing a diagram:
- AI layout / Auto layout automatically rearranges nodes to improve spacing and readability.
- AI fix reviews the diagram for overlaps, dangling connections, clipped labels, or other layout problems and suggests or applies repairs.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Convert a sketch into a diagram
- Select Draw or Draw + Diagram.
- Draw boxes, arrows, labels, and notes.
- Ask: Generate a diagram from my sketch.
- Check the detected labels and connection directions.
- Ask for additional nodes or edits.
Figure 4. Sketch conversion result.
WB-08. Initial sketch with labeled boxes and an arrow.
Supported sketch uploads include PNG, JPG/JPEG, and WebP.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Import a diagram
Import supports:
| Format | Input |
| Mermaid | Mermaid diagram text |
| SQL → ER | CREATE TABLE statements |
| draw.io | .drawio file or compatible XML |
| Excalidraw | Excalidraw diagram file or content |

Figure 5. Import options.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Arrange, save, reopen, and export
- Use the canvas tools to add, move, group, or delete nodes.
- Select Save to store the diagram, freehand canvas, chat, and thumbnail.
- Open All boards to reopen a saved board or search by board name.
- Select Export to download the diagram as draw.io, XMind, or Excalidraw.
Figure 6. All boards page with search.
Export menu with draw.io, XMind, Excalidraw, Mermaid, Image, and Vector options.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Tips
- Name the diagram type, important nodes, and connections in each prompt.
- Use the same conversation for follow-up edits.
- Run Auto layout after large edits or imports, then review the result with AI fix.
- Save before importing, exporting, or leaving the board.
- Use representative labels instead of personal or confidential information.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Limitations
- AI-generated nodes, labels, and relationships should be checked before use.
- Auto layout and AI fix can move diagram content; they do not replace a manual review.
- Import replaces the current diagram.
- Chat changes are not persisted as a server-side checkpoint until the board is saved.
- The documented export formats are draw.io, XMind, and Excalidraw. PNG/SVG export, when available, is client-side.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
Last updated at: 28/07/2026

pages.title: TÀI (Super Agent)
pages.markdown:
# User Guide — TÀI (Super Agent)
# TÀI (Super Agent) — User Guide
## Overview
TÀI is the unified AI assistant that can invoke all specialist agents from a single chat interface. Instead of switching between agents, you can ask TÀI to translate, summarize, create presentations, brainstorm, query your vault, or analyze images — all in one conversation.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## How to Access
TÀI is accessed from the TÀI Studio hub via the top navigation. Click the "TÀI" tab in the Dynamic Island navigation bar.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Interface Layout
Hint chips (shown on empty chat): Click on the triangle with white star at the middle of screen to show full capabilities of TÀI chat
- 🌐 Translate a document
- 📄 Summarize a report
- 💡 Brainstorm strategies
- 📊 Create a presentation
- ✍️ Help me draft an email
- 🔍 Ask about AI vision
| Area | Purpose |
| Left sidebar | Conversation history (previous sessions) |
| Center | Chat interface with hint chips |
| Right sidebar | BYOD (Bring Your Own Data) — manage document indexes |
| Top bar | Tool selector — enable/disable agent tools |

──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## How to Use
### Basic Chat
Type any message and press Enter. TÀI responds with text, and can also trigger actions like file downloads, presentations, or brainstorm canvases.
### File Upload (Human-in-the-Loop)
When TÀI needs a file (e.g., to translate or summarize), it will:
- Display a file upload card in the chat
- You drag and drop or browse for the file
- TÀI automatically resumes processing once the file is uploaded
This is the "interrupt → upload → resume" pattern.
### Multi-Agent Workflows
TÀI can chain multiple agents in a single conversation:
Example: "Translate this file to English then create a summary slide deck" 1. TÀI asks you to upload the file 2. Calls The Translator to translate 3. Calls The Powerpoint-er to create slides from the translation 4. Returns the downloadable PPTX
### Tool Selector
The tools include:
- “Agent” button shows available agent tools (e.g., Translator, Summarizer, PPTX-er) and their current status (active/offline)
- “Knowledge Base” (also check on BYOD Indexes) represents connected data sources used for knowledge retrieval
- “Connector” includes MCP, enabling access to integrated resources
=> Each tool includes a checkbox. Selecting or unselecting this option will enable or disable the tool for use by TÀI.
### BYOD (Bring Your Own Data)
The right sidebar lets you manage personal document indexes:
- Create index — Upload documents to create a searchable knowledge base
- List indexes — See your existing document indexes
- Delete index — Remove an index you no longer need
When a BYOD index is active, TÀI can search it to answer your questions with your own documents as context.
### Conversation History
The left sidebar shows previous sessions:
- Click any session to reload it
- Start a "New chat" to begin fresh
- Sessions are persisted across browser sessions
### Create Agent
Click the Save icon located to the right of the “My Intelligent” button to open the interface for creating a new agent.
Enter the following details:
- Agent Name
- Description
- Custom Instructions
Click “Save” to create and register the new agent.
Created agents are displayed in the left panel, alongside the chat history for easy access.
Available actions for each agent:
- Rename
- Update instructions
- Delete
A dropdown list above the chat field contains all available agents, with TÀI selected by default.
Selecting a different agent from this list switches the active agent for the current conversation.
### User feedback
If the experience does not meet expectations, feedback can be submitted to the development team by clicking the “Send Feedback” button located at the bottom-right corner. This enables sharing ideas or reporting issues to support system improvement and bug fixes.
Within the form, a relevant agent can be selected for the feedback. Clicking “Related Agents” will display a dropdown list, allowing selection of one or more agents.
After completing the form, click “Send Feedback” to submit the input to the development team for further enhancement.
Feedback can also be provided directly within TÀI chat responses:
- 👍 Thumbs Up – indicates satisfaction or positive feedback
- 👎 Thumbs Down – indicates dissatisfaction or unmet expectations
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Available Tools
TÀI has access to these tools (shown in the Tool Selector):
| Tool | What It Does |
| Translate Document | Translates uploaded files via The Translator |
| Summarize Documents | Summarizes uploaded files via The Summarizer |
| Generate Presentation | Creates PPTX via The Powerpoint-er |
| Create Document Index | Creates a BYOD searchable index |
| List My Document Indexes | Shows your BYOD indexes |
| Delete Document Index | Removes a BYOD index |
| Dynamic MCP tools | Additional tools from Genie spaces and custom integrations |

──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## UI Actions
TÀI can render special UI components in the chat:
| Action | Appearance |
| File Upload | Upload card with dropzone |
| File Download | Download button with filename |
| PPTX Download | Presentation card with slide count and download |
| Result Card | Formatted result display |
| Send Feedback | Send user feedback about appication |

──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Tips
- Be featured about what you want — "Translate this to English" is better than "Help me with this file"
- TÀI remembers context within a session — you can refer to previous messages
- Use the Tool Selector to focus TÀI on featured capabilities
- BYOD indexes let you ask questions about your own documents without uploading every time
- Multi-step workflows (translate → summarize → present) work in a single conversation
- TÀI adapts to your language preference over time (cross-session memory)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Limitations
- Depends on all specialist agents being available (check health status in hub)
- Higher latency for multi-agent workflows due to sequential API calls
- File uploads are limited to 20 MB
- Some complex workflows may require multiple back-and-forth messages
- BYOD indexes take time to build (embedding + indexing)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
Last updated: 2026-05-28

pages.title: TÀI Studio GenUI
pages.markdown:
# User Guide — TÀI Studio (Gen UI Rendering)
TÀI produces four types of surfaces in every turn: inline chat rendering, generative UI component surfaces, side-panel artifacts, and tool-driven surfaces. This guide covers all of them, plus the rules that decide which one is used.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 1. Workspace Layout
| Area | What it does |
| Left sidebar | New Chat, conversation history (Pinned + Recent), Agents Hub, Context Hub (COMING SOON), token meter |
| Centre | The chat — where you type and see responses |
| Right panel | Opens on demand for artifacts, file preview, image preview, or specialist editors |

When you first open a new chat, you'll see a personalised greeting and quick-start cards (e.g., Brainstorm, Summarize, Create slides). Click any card to get started.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 2. Composer & Controls
### Mode selector
Click the mode pill in the composer to choose:
| Mode | Best for |
| Auto (default) | Everyday tasks |
| Quick | Simple, fast answers |
| Deep research | Thorough answers using web sources (uses more credits) |
| Think (toggle) | Step-by-step reasoning — combines with any mode |

### @ Mention — routing to specialists
Type @ to open the autocomplete list. Each row shows the handle, description, and type badge (AGENT, MCP, KNOWLEDGE, GENIE). Examples:
- @the-imaginator: a red star logo on white background
- @the-translator: + attach a document
- @the-whiteboarder: loan approval flowchart
### Connect Apps
Click the connector pill to enable/disable external tools (Web Search, Office 365, Confluence, Knowledge Bases, Genie spaces, etc.). Only enabled tools are available for TÀI to use in the current turn.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 3. Inline Chat Rendering
The default surface. TÀI writes the answer directly in the message; the chat renders full GitHub-flavored markdown. When in doubt, the answer stays inline.
### Formatted text
Headings, lists, bold/italic, links, blockquotes — for prose, explanations, analysis, writing.
### Code block
Fenced, syntax-highlighted code with a Copy button. Collapsible in the UI. Format: ```language … ```
### GFM table
Markdown table for small, static structured data. Data returned from a query tool (Genie / SQL) must use a DataTable generative UI surface instead.
### Mermaid diagram
Diagrams rendered inline with Preview / Code tabs and controls: zoom in/out, fit, download, expand, copy source. Format: ```mermaid … ```
### LaTeX math
Inline $…$ and block $$…$$ math expressions — for formulas only, written as LaTeX (no pre-rendered unicode alongside).
### Citations
A trailing ## Sources section is parsed out, [n] markers become clickable links, and a sources panel is rendered. Triggered in Deep research mode.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 4. Generative UI Surfaces (render_a2ui)
A real, interactive surface composed from a fixed catalog of components. The model never writes HTML — it picks components and fills their props. Charts are interactive (Recharts) at runtime.
Used when: quantitative data is genuinely clearer as a visual, the user asks for a dashboard/chart, or query tool results need to be displayed.
### Layout components
| Component | Description | Props |
| Card | Bordered white box around one child | title?, subtitle?, child |
| Row | Children side-by-side (wraps) | children[], gap?, align?, justify? |
| Column | Children stacked vertically | children[], gap?, align?, justify? |
| Section | Titled group of children | title?, children[], gap? |

### Inline elements
| Component | Description | Props |
| Heading | Level 1–3 heading | text, level? |
| Text | Paragraph / label | text, muted? |
| Badge | Status tag in five tones (red, green, blue, amber, gray) | text, color? |
| Divider | Horizontal rule | — |
| Spacer | Vertical whitespace | size? |

### Interactive
| Component | Description | Props |
| Button | Clicking dispatches an action back to the agent | label, variant? (primary|secondary|ghost), action{event{name, context?}} |

### Data & charts
| Component | Description | Props |
| MetricGrid | Responsive KPI grid | metrics[]{label, value, trend?, delta?} |
| BarChart | Bars for comparing categories | title?, data[]{label, value}, orientation? |
| PieChart | Pie/donut for proportions | title?, data[]{label, value} |
| LineChart | Lines for trends over a series | title?, data[], xKey, series[]{key, label?, color?} |
| DataTable | Structured rows — REQUIRED for query-tool results | title?, columns[]{key, label}, rows[] |
| ComparisonTable | Compare items across criteria | title?, items[], criteria[]{label, values[]} |
| Timeline | Vertical event timeline | title?, events[]{date, label, description?} |
| FlowDiagram | Horizontal step flow | title?, steps[]{label, description?} |

### Dashboard layout rules
- Root is always a Column
- All KPIs go in ONE MetricGrid (not individual cards)
- Related charts sit side-by-side in a Row
- Surfaces fill the full width
- Every surface is followed by exactly one short caption sentence
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 5. Side-Panel Artifacts (openArtifact)
A document rendered in a dedicated panel beside the conversation. Used only when the user explicitly asks for a document/artifact, or the content is genuinely long-form.
### Supported formats
| Format | Renders | When to use |
| markdown | Long multi-section document | Reports, essays |
| html | Self-contained designed page (inline CSS & SVG, no network) | Polished one-pagers, under ~3000 words |
| code | Standalone source file | Code in a dedicated space |
| mermaid | Single Mermaid diagram (source only) | One diagram, no prose |
| svg | Complete inline illustration | Self-contained <svg> |

### Artifact panel features
- Copy / Download the content
- Edit inline — select text and give an instruction
- Version navigation — history, diff between versions, restore older versions
- Preview / Code toggle for renderable types
### Brand constraints (HTML artifacts)
| Rule | Value |
| Accent colour | #ed1b24 (TCB red) |
| Text colour | #1a1a1a |
| Muted colour | #6b7280 |
| Border colour | #e5e7eb |
| Fonts | System fonts only — no external resources (sandboxed) |
| Content width | Centered at ~820–880 px |
| Border radius | 10–14 px |
| Font weight | Capped at 700 |

──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 6. Tool-Driven Surfaces
Surfaces produced by specialist tools. Each tool renders its own UI in the chat; the model triggers the tool and the frontend draws the result.
### Job cards & file cards
Long-running tasks (image, diagram, translation, presentation) show a job card that polls status. States: probing → queued → running → done / error / expired. You can keep chatting while it runs.
### Image generation (generate_image)
Renders images inline (square / landscape / portrait). Hover to download, click to preview full-size in the right panel.
### Diagram workspace (open_diagram_workspace)
An editable diagram board. Drag/rearrange nodes, iterate across turns, export to draw.io / Excalidraw / XMind.
### Document tools (hand-off cards)
| Tool | What appears |
| translate_document | File card with download + preview |
| summarize_documents | Summary + "Open mind map in Summarizer" |
| generate_presentation | PPTX card + "Edit slides in chat" |

### Clarification card (ask_clarification)
One question with 2–4 option buttons plus a free-text field. Pauses the turn for your choice. Maximum 2–3 clarification rounds.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 7. Decision Rules — Which Surface, and When
The decision order the model follows:
Rule 1: Inline markdown (default). Text, small tables, code, mermaid, LaTeX. When in doubt, answer inline.
Rule 2: Generative UI (render_a2ui) when quantitative data is clearer as a visual, or the user asks for a dashboard/chart.
- ❗ Rows from a query tool (Genie/SQL) → always DataTable, NEVER markdown table
- ❗ At most ~30 rows per table; state the true total in the caption
- ❗ Every surface followed by exactly one caption sentence
Rule 3: Clarify (ask_clarification) when the request is ambiguous, or chaining 2+ document operations (translate → summarize → slides) — pause after each step for the user to review. Max 2–3 rounds.
Rule 4: Side-panel artifact (openArtifact) only when the user explicitly asks for a document, or the content is genuinely long-form / a designed page.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 8. Response Actions
| Action | What it does |
| Copy | Copy the response to clipboard |
| 👍 / 👎 | Rate the response (opens a feedback form) |
| Regenerate | Get a different response for the same question |

You can edit any sent message (hover → Edit) to re-run with changes. A version navigator < 1/2 > lets you switch between branches.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 9. Token Meter
The sidebar shows your token usage (e.g., 3 / 10,000). Tips to save tokens:
- Start a new chat for a new topic
- Attach only the files you need
- Ask one focused question at a time
At 90% usage, the bar turns red with a warning.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Tips
- Be specific: "Create a 5-slide presentation about cloud security" → gets slides. "Tell me about cloud security" → gets text.
- Use @ to go directly to a specialist.
- Use inline editing in the artifact panel instead of asking TÀI to rewrite everything.
- Job cards update automatically — keep chatting while they run.
- If you need a polished report, ask for an "HTML artifact" — it opens as a designed page in the side panel.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Limitations
| Limitation | Detail |
| No DOCX/XLSX preview | Download only — no inline preview for these types |
| No per-card cancel | Use the global Stop button to halt all processing |
| Language follows your prompt | The EN/VI toggle changes UI only, not response language |
| Context Hub | Shows "COMING SOON" — not available yet |
| ~30 row cap on DataTable | Larger datasets are truncated; true total is in the caption |

──────────────────────────────────────────────────
⚠️ All agent-generated content is advisory only — please review and verify accuracy before use.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
Last updated: 13/08/2026
